scope: Linux bulk transport observations; not complete browser/OS/first-use parity

environment.os: Linux ARM64 in a Docker VM
environment.capture: eth0 Ethernet/veth packets, before netem egress / IFB ingress effects
environment.offloads: GRO, GSO, TSO and UDP segmentation disabled for ordinary interface captures
environment.container_security: NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW; seccomp unconfined, browser sandbox not disabled
environment.timing: Capture spacing is not internal pacing or bare-metal NIC timing; public path, VM scheduling and connection histories vary
